description: Version 4 aggregates cross-evidence by rule and subject (one failed observation keeps the fact failed). Numeric release requires the configured layer count and qualifying assessed cross-evidence; an ordinary contradiction never releases a value. A severe contradiction is computed by the evaluator and needs no independent support, so it releases min(weighted mean, cap) even when the value would otherwise be withheld (version 3 withheld it). Recorder metadata remains eligible for consistency scoring and release, with a non-scoring origin-not-authenticated finding. Integrity is check consistency, not authenticated provenance. Layer weights, confidence formula and severe-contradiction ceiling are unchanged.

layer_weight_rationale.file_integrity: Hash binding and parser success are the hardest evidence to fabricate convincingly; baseline weight.
layer_weight_rationale.declaration_consistency: Declared relationship parameters compared against hash-bound submitted files; this measures consistency, not independent origin authentication.
layer_weight_rationale.cross_evidence_support: One vote per rule and subject; any assessed failure keeps the fact failed. Assessed signed-attestation and recorder-metadata checks qualify for numeric release. Embedded metadata origin is not authenticated by field agreement; its informational finding has no score effect.
